description:
OpenSea is building the gateway to the onchain economy - a rich world of communities, assets & creative expression uniquely possible with native digital ownership. Our products support millions of users and have helped shape onchain markets that exist today—and we're just getting started.

Our goal is to build the highest-leverage, most AI-native team in crypto (and ideally beyond.) We believe that a small team (broken into even smaller teams with extreme ownership) can accomplish enormous results with the right people, the right tools, and the right company-wide investments in AI. We are building that team.

We’re looking for a highly skilled, curious, and self-driven Staff Security Engineer to build the security tools and services that enable OpenSea to move quickly and safely. In this role, you’ll solve security problems emerging from how an AI-native team builds and works. You’ll own internal security software from early ideas and prototypes through production, helping shape what we build and making sure it works reliably as we grow.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate internal security tools and services that secure our engineering workflows and use of AI

  • Turn security prototypes into reliable, maintainable products, improving their architecture, scalability, testing, and observability

  • Own security engineering projects end to end, from identifying the problem and building a solution to deploying, maintaining, and improving it

  • Build and integrate security capabilities such as authentication, authorization, and automated security workflows across our internal systems

  • Improve existing tooling and identify opportunities to automate workstreams so the team can spend more time solving new security problems

  • Work with Engineering and IT to build security defenses and controls into the tools and workflows people use every day

  • Build and ship high-quality, reliable software using agentic development, modern development tools, and strong engineering judgment

  • Help investigate and solve security issues across the company

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering experience building and operating security products, services, or internal security tools

  • Demonstrated ability to take software from prototype to production and improve its reliability, scalability, and maintainability

  • Strong understanding of security principles, including authentication, authorization, threat modeling, and secure system design

  • Experience owning complex, ambiguous technical problems and making independent decisions about architecture, implementation, and trade-offs

  • Experience using AI tools and workflows to build, test, and ship production software, with the ability to evaluate and take ownership of the results

  • An informed perspective on the security challenges of AI-enabled software development

  • An enablement mindset, with the ability to balance engineering velocity and security risk

  • Clear communication and the ability to explain technical decisions and security trade-offs across teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with identity and access management, with additional experience in software engineering or application security

  • Experience in security operations, detection and response, threat intelligence, or vulnerability management

  • Experience building security tooling or enterprise security products

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, or another environment protecting valuable assets

Compensation

The base salary for this full-time position ranges from $240,000 to $295,000 USD for candidates based in the United States and $200,000 to $250,000 USD for candidates based in the European Union, plus benefits & equity. Compensation for candidates based outside of the US and EU will vary to reflect local market conditions.

 

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria above but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

 

#LI-Remote

Benefits & Perks

🏥 Health Benefits: We cover 100% Dental/Vision/Medical for employees and 90% for dependents

🌴 Flexible Time Off Policy: Our flexible time off policy is aimed at letting our employees take as much time off as they'd like to refresh so long as it doesn't interfere with their ability to meet their goals and contribute effectively to company velocity

👶 Parental Leave: 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Bonding & up to 8 additional weeks for the birthing parent

💛 Mental Health: We offer access to Spring Health, covering 8 therapy & 8 coaching sessions per year

📅 11 Company Holidays

🏦 Fidelity 401K Plan

📱 Internet/Mobile Reimbursement Plan

🧘 Reimbursement or Monthly Snack Delivery

✈ Company & Team retreats to get together for fun and collaboration

☕ Team Member Co-Working and Gathering Expense

🖥 MacBook Pro & WFH Stipend to make sure you are set up for success

🌯 Weekly $50 Uber Eats credit

By clicking submit an application below, you consent to our use and processing of your data as described in our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Please be aware that OpenSea participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.
